node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal fiber-resultant interpolation compiler
node.closure: whole-quadratic-fiber diagonal transport, exact facet/product divisors, and a full-support 35-by-12 interpolation kernel
node.statement: For an actual (m,r,delta)=(2,4,2) component stabilized by tau x tau, multiplying the two quadratic source-component fibers over each psi-fiber gives twelve split quartics R_p. They obey diagonal projective transport, the exact K/eta/one-exchange facet supports, and product_p R_p proportional to A^4. These projective quartics interpolate to a biform of bidegree at most (4,4) exactly when a printed 35 x 12 matrix has a full-support kernel. This is an exact deletion compiler, not a proof of universal kernel failure or subgroup/type exclusion.
